serverInfo.name: php-point-of-sale-mcp
serverInfo.title: PHP Point of Sale MCP by usefulapi

result.instructions: Tools for PHP Point of Sale, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How much did we sell yesterday, and which items sold best this week?"; "Which items are below their reorder level?"; "Find the customer with the email jane@example.com and show her last five sales.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes PHP Point of Sale data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run phppos_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run phppos_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run phppos_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. phppos_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: phppos_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the store's locations (shops/warehouses) with name, address, phone, email, time zone and default tax rates, plus each location's registers (id and name). Use the location ids to filter sales, expenses, customers and reports. Payment-processor credentials and device settings are never returned. GET /locations.

offset.description: Rows to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset (paging.next_offset for a report).

tools.name: phppos_list_items
tools.title: List items
tools.description: List or search inventory items with name, item number, category, supplier, prices and reorder level. Search by text, or by one field (name, item_number, product_id, supplier, tag_name...). GET /items.

search_field.description: Limit the search to one field.

category_id.description: Only items in this category id - see phppos_list_categories.

sort_col.description: Column to sort by (a field name of the rows).

offset.description: Rows to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset (paging.next_offset for a report).

tools.name: phppos_get_item
tools.title: Get item
tools.description: One inventory item by id: prices, tax settings, category, supplier, tags, attributes, variations, tier pricing and per-location settings. GET /items/{id}.

item_id.description: PHP Point of Sale item id (find it with phppos_list_items).

tools.name: phppos_list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: List item categories with their ids. Use the ids to filter items or to file a new item. GET /categories.

offset.description: Rows to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset (paging.next_offset for a report).

tools.name: phppos_list_item_kits
tools.title: List item kits
tools.description: List item kits (bundles of items sold together) with their prices. GET /item_kits.

category_id.description: Only kits in this category id.

offset.description: Rows to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset (paging.next_offset for a report).

tools.name: phppos_list_sales
tools.title: List sales
tools.description: List or search completed sales, by date range, customer (id or email) or location. verbosity: minimal (headline fields), medium (adds customer, totals, profit, location - the default here) or full (every line item, payment and tax). Suspended sales (layaways, estimates) are fetched with suspended_type. GET /sales.

start_date.description: Only sales on or after this date or date-time (yyyy-mm-dd or yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss).

end_date.description: Only sales on or before this date or date-time.

email_address.description: Look the customer up by email address and return their sales.

location_id.description: Only sales at this location id - see phppos_list_locations.

suspended_type.description: Fetch suspended sales instead of completed ones: a comma-separated list of layaway, estimate or a sale type name.

offset.description: Rows to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset (paging.next_offset for a report).

tools.name: phppos_get_sale
tools.title: Get sale
tools.description: One sale by id with line items, payments, taxes, customer and employee (verbosity full by default). GET /sales/{id}.

sale_id.description: PHP Point of Sale sale id (the number on the receipt; find it with phppos_list_sales).

offset.description: Rows to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset (paging.next_offset for a report).

tools.name: phppos_list_reports
tools.title: List reports
tools.description: The catalog of the store's reports (138 of them: sales summaries, top sellers, inventory low/aging/summary, profit and loss, taxes, payments, employee, customer, supplier and store-account reports) with the inputs each accepts. Without `search` only the report keys are returned; with `search` (for example 'inventory' or 'profit') the matching reports are returned with their inputs. GET /reports.

search.description: Only reports whose key, description or inputs contain this text.

tools.name: phppos_run_report
tools.title: Run report
tools.description: Run one of the store's reports and return it (title, summary, detail rows); `paging.next_offset` is set when more detail rows remain. Report keys and their inputs come from phppos_list_reports (for example summary_sales, top_sellers, inventory_low, summary_profit_and_loss, summary_taxes, closeout). Typical inputs go in `params`: start_date, end_date, sale_type, location_ids (array), category_id, supplier_id, customer_id, employee_id. A scoped key needs the Reports module plus that report's view permission. GET /reports/{report_key}.

report_key.description: Report key from phppos_list_reports (for example summary_sales or inventory_low).

params.description: The report's inputs as listed by phppos_list_reports, e.g. {"start_date":"2026-10-01","end_date":"2026-10-31","location_ids":[1]}. Do not put limit/offset here.

offset.description: Rows to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset (paging.next_offset for a report).

tools.name: phppos_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a customer in the store. Store-account balance, credit limit and loyalty points cannot be set here. Needs a Read/Write API key. Retrying creates a duplicate (check phppos_list_customers first). The store's 'new customer' webhook, if configured, fires. POST /customers.

first_name.description: First name (required by PHP Point of Sale).

taxable.description: Whether sales to this customer are taxed.

internal_notes.description: Internal notes (not shown to the customer).

tools.name: phppos_update_customer
tools.title: Update customer
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing customer; only the fields you pass are sent. Overwrites the current values. Needs a Read/Write API key. The store's 'edit customer' webhook, if configured, fires. POST /customers/{person_id}.

person_id.description: Customer person id (find it with phppos_list_customers).

taxable.description: Whether sales to this customer are taxed.

internal_notes.description: Internal notes (not shown to the customer).

tools.name: phppos_create_item
tools.title: Create item
tools.description: WRITE: create an inventory item (name required). Stock quantities are not set here. Needs a Read/Write API key. Retrying creates a duplicate (search with phppos_list_items first). The store's item webhooks, if configured, fire. POST /items.

is_service.description: True for a service (no stock tracking).

item_inactive.description: True to deactivate the item (it can no longer be sold).

reorder_level.description: Stock level at which the item shows as low.

tools.name: phppos_update_item
tools.title: Update item
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing item (for example its price, category or active state); only the fields you pass are sent. Overwrites the current values, and a price change applies to the next sale. Needs a Read/Write API key. The store's 'edit item' webhook, if configured, fires. POST /items/{item_id}.

is_service.description: True for a service (no stock tracking).

item_inactive.description: True to deactivate the item (it can no longer be sold).

reorder_level.description: Stock level at which the item shows as low.

tools.name: phppos_create_expense
tools.title: Create expense
tools.description: WRITE: record an expense in the store's books (description, amount and date). It affects expense and profit-and-loss reports. Needs a Read/Write API key. Retrying records it twice (check phppos_list_expenses first). POST /expenses.

expense_amount.description: Amount, in the store's currency, before tax.

expense_date.description: When it was incurred (yyyy-mm-dd or yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss); defaults to now in the store.
